expected.title: A New Friend At School
expected.text: On Monday morning, Lily walks into her new classroom. She is a little nervous, but her teacher smiles and says, "Welcome to our class." A boy named Tom sits near the window. He is friendly and asks, "Are you new here?" Lily nods and says, "Yes, I am in Class Two now." Tom shows her the timetable and tells her about the library. At lunch time, Lily feels better because she has a new classmate and a new friend.
grammar_focus: be 动词的一般现在时
expected.level_rationale: 句子较短，围绕校园与新朋友主题，适合 A2/初中学习者。

comprehension_checks.question: Who is new in the classroom?
Why does Lily feel better at lunch time?
comprehension_checks.answer: Because she has a new classmate and friend.
